checked_by: Antigravity, reading every stated fact directly from reviewToolkit outputs on the live GCS trace (match_overview, death_context, ability_audit, build_check, lane_report, ward_report, key_moments).
source: Live GCS trace with parsed OpenDota match record. A 49:12 Radiant pos-4 support win where Crystal Maiden died 16 times (most on Radiant), including 5 deaths before 10:00 and 5 deaths with Freezing Field ready and not cast.

must_hit.says: Five of the sixteen deaths came before 10:00 (1:54, 3:05, 4:19, 6:14, 7:08), losing the top lane (5,540 vs 6,305 at 10:00) and finishing with the most deaths on the winning team (16).
Died five times with Freezing Field ready and not cast (14:28, 28:07, 34:30, 43:55, 46:08 — 10 casts all game, 5 deaths holding it).

must_not.says: Crystal Maiden's team (Radiant) won in 49:12: a review of a win must not say the game was lost.
